$schema.description: The JSON Schema version used for this schema.

objectType.description: The type of user this schema describes. This is a customer chosen name.

kind.description: Discriminator value for a user schema create request.

metaSchema.description: The user Schema version used for this schema.

properties.description: A map of additional properties for the user definition, where the key is the property name and the value is the property schema

propertyNames.description: A nested value is stored under its dotted path, so a literal dot in a name would be indistinguishable from nesting.
